author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক preposition বসাও (Test Paper থেকে সংগৃহীত)।

items.q: At last God took pity ___ the old sailor.
He was filled ___ a strange wonder.
He felt a great love ___ the water-snakes.
The dead albatross fell ___ his neck into the sea.
A gentle breeze began to blow ___ the south.
items.rule_bn: উৎস বোঝাতে 'from'; বাতাস কোথা থেকে আসে।

items.q: The old man fell ___ a deep sleep.
items.rule_bn: 'fall into sleep' — গভীর ঘুমে তলিয়ে যাওয়া।

items.q: The old man was relieved ___ his sufferings.
Cyberbullying refers ___ the misuse of information technology.
Some people post negative comments ___ somebody.
Everyone is caught up ___ the social network.
It is very easy ___ anyone to misuse this access.
Cyberbullying is an offence punishable ___ the ICT Act.
The wet road glitters ___ reflections of light.
We are taking shelter ___ the balcony.
items.rule_bn: আশ্রয়ের স্থান বোঝাতে under/in/on বসতে পারে।
